description: Starts a comment thread on a slide of a report, or replies to a thread, as the user. A reply notifies the thread's other participants who can still open the report. Members who can comment on the report may.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

slideId.description: The slide to start a new thread on, as `slideId` in `getReportContent`. Leave it out with `threadId`.

text.description: The comment, as plain text: each line becomes a paragraph, and Markdown marks such as `**` and `#` are removed. Mentions and @Rollstack requests can only be written in the app. At most 5000 characters.
examples: Updated the EMEA numbers on this slide.

threadId.description: The thread to reply to, by its first comment's `id` from `listReportComments`. The reply goes on the thread's slide, and the thread's other participants are notified.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: createReportComment
title: Add comment
